structural_change: b8 (S-ELEM-PQ/COLL 10-16, VIS-ROM S81H-04 visual audit of CLOSED b7: cells against the W/E/S walls, 74% empty, diagonal SW->mid chain + SW congestion knot): NARROW=1 drops the 562 input pins the leaf never reads (host_rx 514, gather_tag 24, reduced_tag 24; same logic, 0 edges); E pins aligned to their t_vm destination rows; S spread over the whole face at 7.98 pins/um with raw_sources from the W end. Outline 151.2x237.6 and faces kept (pin-bound: W/E height, S width). | b7 NATIVE FIX: b6 CLOSED (TT +61.09/FF +10.38/DRC0) but native audit FAILED: rst_n capture 271.3 > 190 (raw reset pin straight into async-reset recovery) and 10 launches <= 249.4 > 220 (t_crq row bits on DFFASRHQNx1 async-reset output registers; t_vm[100/105/112] 220-234). Structural: registered local ot_rst_relay (init-only +3 edges) and plain t_crq row registers (only the valid bit keeps reset); no normal edge, outline, pin or price change. | b6 (10-15 S-ELEM-B): b5 GRT-0116 = the common wide-bus cause (ref_tile default PPL ordered 32-pin groups pack a face where its flops sit: S face x34-79 um, 259 GCells, nets ot_ihdrv/ot_inhold = input hold pads in that band; total usage only 28%). Fix as headp p4 / align p2: explicit even spreading of all 6,614 pins over their granted faces (spread_face_pins.py; S 1,651 M3/M5, N 1,220, W 1,909 / E 1,834 M4) and no output hold pads (receivers carry input hold stages). Same RTL/outline/faces. | 10-15 S-ELEM-B: first hardening of the static collective -> VM boundary (die grant die_grants_1015: kit_allowed, provisional origin [1479.6, 0] in sp_collective). Same faces as the owner's slot request; width 248.4 -> 151.2 so the E-face gather_data (2,048 b) -> W-face t_vm (2,204 b) register path crosses 151 um instead of 248 um (pin -> mux -> t_vm flop inside the 190 ps native capture budget); height 216 -> 237.6: the W face (2,234 b) on M4 at 2 tracks needs > 216 um (pin_fit PPL-0093 at 99 % slots), S 1,651 b at 10.9 b/um. 0 cycles (source unchanged: sha ce6385c2). | gate b1 (PINCAP 0): in->reg -62 ps through the pack/valid logic, pack_bad_out in->out -219, raw_sources[0]/hc_write_slot 539-1,087 loads, rst_n 2,220 loads. b2 = PINCAP 1: every write-path input pin-captured (+1 fixed edge collective->VM write; the read request t_crq is unchanged), pack_bad_out registered (fault only), reset only on the 4 valid bits + t_crq + fault. Slab gate PINCAP 1 PASS, MUT FAIL; PINCAP 0 PASS.
